blocks.text: LEADER OF ISRAEL AFTER MOSES · THE TRIBES OF ISRAEL
Joshua. Led Israel over the Jordan and divided the land by lot.
LED ISRAELi
Not given Not given in Scripture: from Moses' death to his own death at 110
TRIBE
Ephraim
IN THE LINE
2nd of 15
SCRIPTURE SAYS
“A man in whom is the spirit"; "full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him".”
PROPHETS
None named
THE TRIBES OF ISRAEL: 15 RULERS MOSES → SAMUEL
ACCESSION
How Joshua came to power
His first command: Moses sent him to fight Amalek at Rephidim. Exodus 17:9–13
He was Moses' "minister", went up the mount with him, and "departed not out of the tabernacle". Exodus 24:13 Exodus 33:11 Numbers 11:28
One of the twelve spies, he and Caleb urged the people to enter the land, and alone of their generation were promised it. Numbers 14:6–10 Numbers 14:30
At Moses' request God named Joshua; Moses laid hands on him before Eleazar and the congregation. Numbers 27:15–23
Moses charged him before all Israel, and God charged him at the tabernacle. Deuteronomy 31:7–8 Deuteronomy 31:14 Deuteronomy 31:23
After Moses died, the LORD spoke to Joshua; the people answered "All that thou commandest us we will do". Joshua 1:1–3 Joshua 1:16–18
SUCCESSION
Before and after
WHAT SCRIPTURE SAYS
What Scripture says of him
"A man in whom is the spirit"; "full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him". Numbers 27:18 Deuteronomy 34:9
God promised him: "as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee". Joshua 1:5 Joshua 3:7
The LORD "magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses". Joshua 4:14
"So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country." Joshua 6:27
"Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua", and of the elders who outlived him. Joshua 24:31 Judges 2:7
"The servant of the LORD" is the title given him at his death. Joshua 24:29 Judges 2:8
With the Gibeonites he made a league without asking the LORD: the men "asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD". Joshua 9:14–15
EVENTS
Wars, works and turning points
Each mark sits at the year of the reign the Bible gives for it.
UNDATED IN SCRIPTURE
THE LAND
Gilgal, the first camp; later Shiloh and the places of the reign

THE NATION
What the nation did
The new generation was circumcised and kept the Passover at Gilgal. Joshua 5:2–3 Joshua 5:10
The covenant was renewed at Ebal and again at Shechem. Joshua 8:30–35 Joshua 24:25–27
"Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua." Joshua 24:31
ON THE WORLD STAGE
The powers of the day
THE KINGS OF THE SOUTH
Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem · Hoham of Hebron · Piram of Jarmuth · Japhia of Lachish · Debir of Eglon
THE KINGS OF THE NORTH
Jabin of Hazor · Jobab of Madon
THE PHILISTINES
DATES DIFFER
When was it?
SCRIPTURE'S OWN NUMBERS
No years given
Scripture gives no length for Joshua's leadership and no year BC. Caleb's ages imply about seven years of war before the land was divided (see the open question).
One place; "heres" (sun) and "serah" are the same letters reversed
Moore (1895); Keil treats them as one place (1872 printing)

Moore calls "Timnath-heres" in Judges 2:9 "probably a metathesis" of Timnath-serah, made "to get rid of a name of heathenish sound"; Keil simply notes that Timnath-serah is "called Timnath-heres in Judg. ii. 9" and places it at Tibneh.[22][8]
Two names, an older and a newer
Hävernick, as reported by Moore
Hävernick took Timnath-heres for the old Canaanite name and Timnath-serah for the Israelite one.[22]

WHAT SCRIPTURE DOES NOT SAY
Scripture gives no length for Joshua's leadership and no year BC for the conquest.
Joshua named no successor. After him came "the elders that outlived Joshua" (Judges 2:7), and then the judges.
No prophet is named speaking to Joshua; the LORD speaks to him directly (Joshua 1:1).
Joshua is never called a king or a judge.
IDENTIFICATIONS THIS PAGE RELIES ON
Moses renamed "Oshea the son of Nun" of Ephraim "Jehoshua". Numbers 13:8 Numbers 13:16
Chronicles lists "Jehoshua" son of Non in Ephraim's line, and Nehemiah calls him "Jeshua the son of Nun". 1 Chronicles 7:27 Nehemiah 8:17

From the textThe site's person record also attaches Acts 7:45 and Hebrews 4:8 to him: in both verses the KJV's "Jesus" is the Greek form of Joshua's name, and the context is Israel's entry into the land. Acts 7:45 Hebrews 4:8
